name: contract-history-blob-cache
goal: History reconstruction shares bounded immutable blob reads across source revisions with verified Git object formats

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The ten-revision all-source history sample takes68.46 seconds and about2.98GB peak RSS. CommitTreeAdapter caches text only per instance, re-reading unchanged source blobs in later trees. Reuse must be bounded and keyed only after establishing Git object format.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The adapter has no own method/state suite; the platform catalog integration only proves selected-revision values. Initial entity-contract migration adds the complete three-public-method by empty/populated matrix, six stable cases. Strengthen read/populated for repeated blob reads and original-tree isolation; open/populated rejects unknown formats.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
